question: In a code language, 'TREASURE' is written as 'GIVZHFIV', 'OCEAN' is written as 'LXVZM'. How will 'PIRATE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

According to the English alphabet and its positional values:

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

**Each alphabet is coded as the positional value of the opposite alphabet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/772d89508b285505051339c788c924c8688ad7f2f5fdec7cdb8784438d0e8731.png] 

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a31a8d4395585d76e8fac5ae0df2b0e462bbe0c8d831c985b294ea2323d6c69b.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c60d2594d092fe09a2a300547805445b61aed6f64264603ad4557ba2e2ebbc1a.png]
